title: Vibe coding complex changes in Rust
summary: Jon Gjengset spends about three hours livecoding complex changes in a Rust codebase with agentic AI tools, testing his hypothesis that AI is weak at non-pattern work. He documents where Claude Code helps and where it struggles.
why: Pointed to as a non-promotional, realistic long session of an experienced engineer working with AI on non-trivial code.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I found this one and sat down and watched the whole three hours.
